company.shortDescription: Airtrain AI is an AI data platform that specializes in data curation, fine-tuning, and evaluation for LLMs.
company.description: Airtrain AI is the AI Data Platform. From our LLM Playground to our Dataset Explorer to batch evaluation and custom LLM fine-tuning — Airtrain enables AI teams to build and deploy scalable, precise, data-intensive AI workflows easily while reducing operational costs. Built by Machine Learning veterans from Cruise and Instacart, today Airtrain technology is trusted by AI professionals in a wide range of global industries. For more information, visit https://airtrain.ai or follow us on Twitter at https://twitter.com/AirtrainAI or YouTube at https://www.youtube.com/@AirtrainAI.
